title: Fix the Stuck Binary Search
description: The program should search for a target value in a sorted list using binary search, correctly reporting -1 if it isn't present. Fix the bug.
expectedBehavior: Searching for 4 (which is not in the list) should conclude that it isn't present and print -1.
actualProblem: When narrowing the search range, low is set to mid (instead of mid + 1) and high is set to mid (instead of mid - 1). For a target that is never found, like 4 here, mid ends up recomputing to the exact same value on every iteration, so the range never shrinks and the loop runs forever instead of eventually returning -1.
explanation: Each half of a binary search must strictly exclude the already-checked middle index, or the search range stops shrinking. Using mid + 1 and mid - 1 guarantees progress toward the loop terminating, even when the target is never found.
